meta_description:
2,083 likes, 10 comments - the_unconventional_ca on July 28, 2026: "A great business can still become a terrible investment.

Most investors study balance sheets.

Very few study the people running the company.

Apurva Sharma shares how a promoter battle at Shalimar Paints turned a ₹150 stock into ₹50 and completely changed the way he invests.

Sometimes, the biggest risk isn’t the market.

It’s management.

Watch this one before you buy your next stock.

(Stock market India, Investing, Shalimar Paints, Corporate Governance, Promoter Conflict, Minority Shareholders, Value Investing, Investing Mistakes, Wealth Creation, Business Strategy)

#stockmarketindia #investing #wealthcreation #businessstrategy #personalfinance".
